priorityList: Summon your pet before combat if you have the Unbreakable Bond talent.
Open combat by casting Aimed Shot.
Cast Volley on cooldown to trigger Sentinel and Trick Shots mechanics.
Activate Trueshot as soon as it is available, ideally while Volley is active.
Use offensive Trinkets, Racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury), and Potions while Trueshot is active.
Cast Arcane Shot whenever Precise Shots is active to consume the buff.
Cast Rapid Fire if the Unload talent is active and either the target is below 20% health or you have high stacks of Bulletstorm.
Cast Aimed Shot if you are at or near 2 charges to prevent capping.
Cast Rapid Fire on cooldown to generate Focus and maintain the Bulletstorm buff.
Cast Aimed Shot as your primary Focus spender when other high-priority abilities are on cooldown.
Use Steady Shot as a filler to generate Focus when you have nothing else to press.
